spec_references: Expressions: [Literal] — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only; [List constructor]; [Variable reference]; [Member access expression]; [lvexpr]
reason: The case checks rejection of array indices with string or mixed finite int/string types and negative constant indices, including unary-minus expressions and indexed assignment. These are negative checks within supported type definitions, constants, member access, assignments, literals and unary numeric operators; no applicable subset restriction excludes them.
test_design_notes: Five @error annotations assert compile-time rejection. There are no @args, @panic or @output execution assertions.
